title: Ghosts from the Past (miniquest)
start: Speak to Quartermaster Gully on the docks near the Sarim's Revenge.

rewards.t: 1 Medium XP lamp in one of the following skills: scl | Agility , scl | Herblore , scl | Fishing , scl | Thieving , scl | Cooking , scl | Prayer , scl | Runecrafting , scl | Slayer , scl | Construction , scl | Hunter , scl | Dungeoneering , or scl | Divination
Islands That Once Were Turtles teleport tablet unlocked in the Waiko Reward Shop
rewards.l: Islands That Once Were Turtles teleport

steps.t: Travel to The Islands That Once Were Turtles.
p: Place: The Islands That Once Were Turtles

steps.t: Talk to Quartermaster Gully (if you have just completed Harbringer you may need to relog for the chat option to show up). [Chat: 1 Ghosts from the Past miniquest. › Accept › 5 Enough questions. Let's move on.]
Climb both watchtowers on the island and talk to both skeletons of the Skulls pirate and the Skulls mercenary.
p: Getting information from one of the skeletons.

steps.t: Continue north and climb up the observatory.

sub.t: Talk to the skeleton of the Skulls thief at the top.

steps.t: Return to Quartermaster Gully. [Chat: 1 Ghosts from the Past miniquest.]
